record.field: Welcome to the new self-service app
Request your leaves, loans and follow your payslips from your phone.
From today every request goes through the self-service app. Ask your branch supervisor if you need help to sign in.
Uniform, hair net and gloves are mandatory in the kitchen.

• Clean uniform at every shift.
  • Hair net and gloves in the kitchen.
  • No jewellery while handling food.
New temperature log for the cold rooms, twice per shift.
Record the cold room temperature at the start and the end of each shift.
